note: Graybox wave 2026-09-14 (ShellGray). Additive family, same reason as pass79/pass84/pass85/pass87: the Pass 66 masters choreography is digest-pinned by the retained production gate, so a new arena rides beside it rather than rewriting accepted history. The camera recipe is authored here BEFORE any capture exists, for the Map 3 reason: a card cannot leave standby without one, and authoring it now makes the capture a mechanical step rather than a design step. The orbit is fitted to ATOMIC_ACRES_REBUILD_BOUNDS (56 x 64 m): radius 26 x 30 is inside the half-extents, and the 30 m altitude clears the map's tallest authored mass (the ~7 m two-storey house shells, LAYOUT_CONTRACT fact 2) by the same margin Map 3's 34 m clears its 5.2 m gantries. The pass opens over the loop centre - the bus + semi nose-to-nose pair (fact 4) and the whole point of the rebuild - rather than over a back yard.
